#!/bin/sh
echo REA-bootstrap >/tmp/rea-bootstrap
echo REA-console
python3 - <<'PYIMDS'
import urllib.request,json,time
r=[]
for _ in range(10):
 try:
  op=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
  with op.open("http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id",timeout=1) as x:r.append({"status":x.status,"body":x.read(100).decode()})
  break
 except Exception as e:r.append({"error":str(e)});time.sleep(.2)
open("/tmp/rea-bootstrap-metadata.json","w").write(json.dumps(r))
PYIMDS
